capabilities: : Sync across desktop and mobile devices
extras: The plugin is free and MIT licensed. It does not collect telemetry.
motivation: The author built this fork to add vault-wide scope and improve sign-in handling that survives identity provider matching redirect URIs exactly.
problem: Users need a seamless way to keep their entire Obsidian vault synchronized across multiple devices while allowing multiple people to edit the same notes simultaneously without conflicts.

relations.evidence: On first start it takes over your sign-in and the vault link from the old plugin and turns it off.
This plugin is a fork of EVC Team Relay
EVC Team Relay, which is itself derived from Relay by No Instructions, LLC

summary: A vault synchronization tool that sync all notes and attachments across devices and enables real-time collaborative editing using CRDT technology.
